purpose: Prove the exact Mem-Gallery file snapshot, JSON schema, official-runner traversal order, question denominator, stable question IDs, and all image references before any static-track numerical run.

upstream_runner_alignment.dataset_order: Sorted dialog filename stems, matching get_available_datasets().
upstream_runner_alignment.question_order: Zero-based enumerate order of the human-annotated QAs list within each sorted dialog file.
upstream_runner_alignment.conversation_image_resolution: ../image/<path> resolves beneath data/image; any other relative conversation path is interpreted beneath data and must still resolve beneath data/image.
upstream_runner_alignment.question_image_resolution: ../image/<path> and other relative question image paths resolve beneath data/image.
upstream_runner_alignment.strictness_delta: The audit rejects absolute paths, traversal, symlinks, malformed image lists, missing referenced images, empty questions, and non-string answers that the upstream runner might otherwise skip or tolerate. It validates every image-list element even though the runner consumes the first element. This changes no method input; it prevents a denominator or path ambiguity before execution.

paths.freshness: The integrity evidence root must be absent. A rejected audit is retained, and any recovery uses a separately frozen successor evidence root. The dataset root is read-only input and is never modified or deleted.

stable_outputs.dataset-integrity.json: Aggregate file, schema, traversal, denominator, and semantic dataset identity.
stable_outputs.question-index.jsonl: One canonical row per question, including stable qid and hashes of question, answer, and canonical raw QA object.
stable_outputs.QID_ORDER.txt: Exact official-runner-compatible question order used by every matched static method.
stable_outputs.image-references.json: Every conversation and question image reference plus resolved, referenced, and unreferenced frozen image inventories.
stable_outputs.EVIDENCE_SHA256SUMS: SHA-256 identities for all four accepted evidence payloads.
stable_outputs.TERMINAL_ACCEPTED: Created only after every acceptance condition passes.

acceptance_rule: The materialization acceptance marker exists and its rejection marker is absent; the dataset has exactly the frozen 1515 paths and 545845389 bytes with every LFS SHA-256 or non-LFS Git blob SHA-1 verified; all 20 JSON files parse under the runner-aligned schema; exactly 1711 nonempty questions produce unique ordered qids; every image reference resolves to one of the frozen 1490 image paths without absolute paths, traversal, or symlinks; stable evidence files and their SHA-256 inventory exist; exactly one TERMINAL_ACCEPTED marker exists and no rejection marker exists.
failure_rule: Any prerequisite, file identity, path inventory, JSON schema, denominator, qid uniqueness, image reference, symlink, or evidence-write failure rejects the audit. The dataset and failure evidence are retained without mutation or deletion; recovery requires a frozen successor.
downstream_gate: No Mem-Gallery method may begin lifecycle ingestion, retrieval, generation, scoring, or result admission until this exact evidence root is TERMINAL_ACCEPTED and its semantic dataset identity and QID_ORDER hash are frozen into the method execution prefreeze.
scientific_boundary: This audit establishes reusable dataset identity and matched ordering only. It accepts no method result, metric, ranking, superiority claim, or SOTA claim.
explicitly_prohibited: using a different dataset revision or mutable branch
using upstream tolerance to silently skip malformed questions or images
filling session or dialogue-round counts from a webpage instead of measuring the frozen snapshot
starting a static numerical run before integrity acceptance
editing a rejected evidence root or retrying it in place
deleting or modifying the materialized dataset through any model cleanup stage
